text:
alex: quick follow-up from the CP split spike. Proposal: introduce a CP facade for private tenants that returns only logical endpoint URNs (e.g. urn:redwood:tenant:t123:endpoint:e7) and never emits region/AZ identifiers. relays map URNs -> provider attachments locally. thoughts?

rachel: interesting. CP facade reduces topology leakage. how do customers pin region for compliance?

alex: opt-in affinity flag on tenant config. default opaque. example: affinity_mode: explicit / affinity_list: [us-east-1] if set, CP will record the policy but still return URNs; relays enforce placement.

tom: quota/enforcement concern: CP won't see per-region load. we should issue short-lived quota leases to relays that they enforce locally and reconcile periodically.

maria: agree. propose lease TTL=3m for token quotas and leader TTL=45s. relays periodically fetch leases and can serve during short CP outages.

relay-bot: relay-bot: alex/opaque-cp-facade staged to relay-9 at 2026-06-01T11:34:00Z :white_check_mark:

alex: operational questions: 1) bootstrap relays without CP returning region? relays register with CP with signed certs and receive tenant URN mappings for the tenants they serve. 2) debugging: CP exposes locality hints (proximate/remote) and anonymized latency buckets; support can request a signed relay debug token for verbose logs.

rachel: split-brain risk during cutover if two relays think they're leader for same tenant. need CP-signed leader token per (tenant, relay) with monotonic epoch and renewal window.

tom: add takeover tests: delayed leader renewals, rapid attach/detach churn, and route table GC. Also test CP unreachable for 10m with cached leases.

maria: UI change: hide region names, show locality hints and percentile latency. prepare FAQ explaining why we don't show regions and how to request support-level logs.

alex: next steps: write RFC addendum describing lease formats, leader epoch semantics, relay registration flow, and support debug token TTL/policy. run a 72h canary: 20 tenants on relay-9. I'll open repo PR by EOD.

rachel: +1. I'll draft runbook for relay demotion and reattach.

tom: +1. adding tests to integration suite.

alex: thanks all. if no objections we proceed with canary. :thumbsup:
